metadata.description: Skills for deploying Treasure AI ML solutions and custom AI agents — templates bundled locally, all engagement outputs written to a git-ignored agent_outputs/ folder

plugins.name: ai-signals-skills
plugins.description: AI Signals ML workflow skills for Treasure AI including RFM segmentation, multi-touch attribution (MTA), binary classification, journey analytics, next best action (NBA), and next best product (NBP). Trigger on: RFM, CLV, churn, classifier, classification, propensity, lead scoring, MTA, attribution, NBA, NBP, customer segmentation, predictive model, ML workflow.

plugins.name: custom-agent-skills
plugins.description: Custom AI agent skills for Treasure AI: the Custom Audience Agent for CDP audience, customer-data and segment analysis and segment creation on any parent segment, and the Custom Dashboard Builder for building or resuming custom HTML dashboards from Treasure Data through a questionnaire-led 5-phase pipeline. Trigger on: audience agent, audience analysis, segment analysis, create a segment, CDP analysis, build a dashboard, KPI dashboard, HTML dashboard, resume dashboard, Sisense .dash migration.
